subject: Bugbear Warrior
picture: All-ages fantasy coloring book page, portrait. Outline art only. A tall bugbear warrior drops through a broken crack in a dungeon-hall ceiling to ambush below. Large hairy goblinoid, not a troll: blunt snout, short pointed ears, fur in large clumps, hide armor plates, one spiked club. Through the ceiling crack you can see the room above: wooden joists and floorboards or large stone slabs of the upper floor, plus a few hanging broken stones. That upper floor fills the hole. No blank white sky and no solid black void. No floor puddle. No page frame. The hall has block walls, a fully closed wooden door, large flagstones, one crate, one barrel. Every region is a closed white shape to color.
